result.rationale: The new parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the zod safeParse result wrapper (it returns `refreshTokenResponse`, the SafeParseReturnType, not `.data`). In googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` and then persists `data: { key }`, so the credential row would be overwritten with `{success, data: {...}}` instead of the parsed credential — unlike the office365 usage which correctly unwraps via `tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data`.
